item.title: Jaylen Brown, Nikola Vucevic lead Celtics to historic blowout of Nets
item.description: Two days after their worst shooting performance of the season, the Celtics delivered their best in a 148-111 obliteration of the Nets.

item.title: Trump’s ‘America First’ campaign battle cry gives way to military strikes abroad
item.description: Trump’s decision to strike Iran pulls him toward the kind of conflict he once attacked.

item.title: Travis Konecny, Dan Vladar lead Flyers past Bruins, 3-1

item.title: Tobias Myers set for long relief role with Mets
item.description: Tobias Myers wasn't the headliner of the trade that brought him to the Mets, and he isn't exactly a headliner in spring training, but the right-hander is set to play a valuable role for the club in 2026 as a starter/long reliever.

item.description: WINSTON-SALEM, N.C. (AP) — Myles Colvin scored 32 points on a near-perfect shooting effort and Wake Forest rallied in the second half to defeat Syracuse 88-83 on Saturday night.
